explication: Claudix is a VS Code extension that embeds Claude Code in an editor webview. The documented user flow is to open the chat, start or resume a conversation, request coding help, and review tool permissions. The repository separates the webview experience, extension-side Claude orchestration, and VS Code services; it also includes session-history and settings surfaces. The README documents product capabilities, while sampled source confirms selected internal links; other runtime wiring is not inferred where excerpts do not show it.
